status: Illustrative semi-open station; geometry, loads, airflow and occupancy are assumptions, not measurements of a named station
outdoor_radiant_note: Shaded longwave approximation, separately specified; not a physical identity between radiant and air temperature
air_exchange_note: Balanced outdoor exchange surrogate; the last two minutes of each cycle are an assumed arrival/opening disturbance, not a piston-flow law
occupancy_note: Mean simultaneous people rise linearly throughout each headway and reset at departure; fractional counts represent a deterministic average
person_load_note: Vapor rate estimated as 45 W / (2.45 MJ/kg); enthalpy source is g*(2501000+1860*T), not a second added 45-W latent term
device_note: Three units per strategy, one in each zone. All electric input is assigned to zone sensible heat. Local speeds and recirculation flows are assumed, not derived from electrical ratings. Direct evaporative units recirculate local air; liquid-water enthalpy and carryover are neglected.
